articles.summary: Waste Connections, Inc. (TSX/NYSE: WCN) (Waste Connections or the Company) today announced the results of its annual meeting of shareholders (the Meeting). All eight director nominees in the Companys 2026 management information circular and proxy statement (the Proxy Statement) were nominated and elected as directors of the Company at the Meeting. Each director will serve until the close of the next annual meeting of shareholders or until his or her earlier resignation, or his or her successor is duly elected or appointed.
